column1: # Original DICE Hi-Way, DIP 6 (extended play at 60, regular traffic both ways), play-time potentiometer
# 510 kOhm (the original default). The coin (500 ms) starts the game; the accelerator is held from 1000 ms.
# The wheel axis alone turns the car left (2000-2300 ms) and right (3000-3300 ms); recorded closed-loop
# steering with the wheel axis (4500-50000 ms, accelerator released 30000-36000 ms) and the wheel keys
# (50000-91000 ms) keeps the car on the road; the timer ends the game; a coin restarts it.
